text: Purpose: Pins core package - handles versioning, caching, distribution. Architecture (Transparent Users): - Public Hub: pkgdown-served board https://flmnh-ai.github.io/petrographer/pins/ - Consumed via board_url(), served pkgdown/assets/pins/ repo - Updated maintainers, auto-deployed via GitHub Pages - Local Dataset Board: .petrographer/datasets/ project root (auto-created) - dataset pins stored - Users reference dataset_id train_model() - Local Model Board: .petrographer/models/ project root (auto-created) - train_model() automatically pins trained models - Users load from_pretrained(model_id, board = "local") - Custom Boards: Advanced users can specify board_folder("path") either datasets models Board Separation: Datasets models use separate boards allow identical names without collision: Key Functions: - from_pretrained(model_id, board = NULL) - Load model (NULL = hub, “local” = model board) - pin_model(model_dir, model_id, board) - Pin model board - pin_dataset(data_dir, dataset_id, board) - Pin dataset board - list_models(board) / list_trained_models() - List available models - list_datasets(board) - List available datasets - model_info(model_id, board) - Show model metadata - get_training_dataset(model_id, board) - Retrieve exact dataset version used train model Internal Helpers: - .get_dataset_board() - Returns local dataset board (exported) - .get_model_board() - Returns local model board (exported) Dataset Version Tracking (Reproducibility): Models automatically track exact dataset version used training. ensures reproducibility allows retrieve training data later: dataset version ID (e.g., "20251013T143943Z-8329a") stored model metadata used retrieve correct pins version. works even dataset updated since training. Maintainer Workflow (Publishing Hub): 1. Pin model: pin_model(model_dir, model_id, hub_board) 2. Update manifest: pins::write_board_manifest(hub_board) 3. Rebuild pkgdown: pkgdown::build_site() 4. Commit & push GitHub 5. Model appears hub deployment Refactored (2025-10): Separated datasets models different boards prevent namespace collisions allow names related datasets/models. Training auto-pins local boards.

HPC training useful : - Large datasets requiring long training times - Multi-GPU training - Running multiple experiments parallel Configure HPC connection per session: can also set via .Renviron: Training mode auto-detected based hipergator configuration. Use train_model() call: Customize HPC resources job: Behind scenes, train_model(): Uploads artifacts HPC: Dataset → base_dir/datasets/{dataset_id}/ Training script → base_dir/scripts/train.py use rsync - unchanged files skipped! Submits SLURM job : Working directory: base_dir Command uses relative paths (clean, portable) GPU allocation via hipergator resource spec Monitors job completion Downloads results: model_best.pth (weights) config.yaml (model config) metadata.json (class names) metrics.json (training history) Pins model local board easy loading HPC uses efficient shared structure avoid re-uploading: means: - First training uploads everything - Subsequent trainings upload changed files - Multiple models can share datasets scripts training fails: 1. Check error messages R console 2. Verify base_dir exists HPC 3. Ensure dataset paths correct 4. Check GPU availability partition
code: library(hipergator)  # Configure HiPerGator connection hpg_configure(   host = "hpg",   base_dir = "/blue/mygroup/myusername/petrographer" ) PETROGRAPHER_HPC_HOST=hpg.rc.ufl.edu PETROGRAPHER_HPC_BASE_DIR=/blue/mygroup/myusername/petrographer # Same call as local training - HPC mode auto-detected! model_id <- train_model(   data_dir = "data/processed/my_dataset",   model_id = "my_detector_hpc_v1",   num_classes = 3,   max_iter = 12000   # No hpc_* params needed - uses hipergator config! ) model_id <- train_model(   data_dir = "data/processed/my_dataset",   model_id = "my_large_model",   num_classes = 5,   max_iter = 20000,    # HPC resource hints   gpus = 2,                    # Multi-GPU training   hpc_cpus_per_task = 28,      # CPUs (default: 14 per GPU)   hpc_mem = "48gb",            # Memory (default: 24gb per GPU)    # Batch size must be divisible by GPU count   ims_per_batch = 16           # 8 per GPU ) /blue/base_dir/ ├── datasets/ │   └── my_dataset_v1/          # Shared across all models │       ├── train/ │       └── valid/ ├── scripts/ │   └── train.py                # Shared script └── models/     └── my_detector_hpc_v1/         └── 20250113120000/     # Run ID (timestamp)             └── output/                 ├── model_best.pth                 ├── config.yaml                 └── metadata.json # Check HPC connection hipergator::hpg_check_connection()  # View your base directory hipergator::hpg_show_base_dir()  # List running jobs (if you have access) # hipergator provides job monitoring functions

text: dataset_id Name pinned dataset use training (preferred). data_dir Path dataset directory (alternative dataset_id; auto-pinned temp ID). model_id Name trained model (used pins). Defaults dataset_id provided. num_classes Number object classes dataset. backbone Model backbone: "resnet50" (default), "resnet101", "resnext101", full Detectron2 model zoo key. freeze_at Freeze backbone stage: 0 (freeze nothing), 1 (freeze stem), 2 (freeze stem + res2; default). Lower values train layers = slower better domain adaptation. max_iter Maximum training iterations. Default: 2000. learning_rate Learning rate detection head. NULL (default), uses smart auto-scaling based freeze_at batch size. Backbone automatically gets 0.1x rate. number provided, uses exact value head (backbone still gets 0.1x). device Device local training: 'cpu', 'cuda', 'mps' (default: 'cuda'). eval_period Validation evaluation frequency iterations (default: 500). checkpoint_period Checkpoint saving frequency (0 = final ; > 0 = every N iters). ims_per_batch Total images per iteration across GPUs. NA (default), uses 2 images per GPU. num_workers DataLoader workers per process (Detectron2). NULL (default), set images per GPU. hpc_cpus_per_task Optional SLURM cpus-per-task hint HPC training. hpc_mem Optional SLURM memory hint HPC training (e.g., "24gb", "96gb"). gpus Number GPUs HPC training (default: 1; ignored local).
